title: Which Willem Dafoe Character Are You, Deep Down?
dek: One actor, eight completely unhinged range points — answer honestly and find out which Dafoe role has been living inside you the whole time.

quiz.intro: No wrong answers — just go with your gut.

questions.question: It's 2 a.m. and you can't sleep. What are you actually doing right now?

answers.text: Scheming in a lab no one's allowed into
Standing watch so everyone else can rest easy
Telling anyone within earshot a wild sea story over a bottle
Wrestling with a decision that could change everything

questions.question: Your friend group is falling apart. What's your role in the drama?

answers.text: I try to keep everyone on the right path, even if it costs me
I dig in, refuse to budge, and dare anyone to challenge me
I quietly carry everyone's burden without saying a word
I'm the one people call at midnight when things go sideways
A remote outpost where I answer to absolutely no one
Wherever people need something to believe in
A scrappy little business I basically run singlehandedly
An advisory role, shaping whoever comes after me

questions.question: How do you handle it when someone you trusted betrays you?

answers.text: I forgive them, even though it costs me everything
I quietly cover for them and hope they figure it out eventually
I risk looking like the villain myself just to set things right
I let it become one more thing weighing me down in silence
Showing up when it matters, no questions asked
Mentorship, plus a few hard truths
Brooding intensity from a safe emotional distance
Enthusiastic, slightly needy devotion

questions.question: What does your ideal vacation actually look like?

answers.text: A deep-sea kingdom, obviously
Driving all night with no destination in mind
A boat trip with my whole found family, matching outfits included
Somewhere I can build something nobody else understands yet

questions.question: What's your biggest flaw, if you're being real?

answers.text: I isolate myself instead of just asking for help
I need constant reassurance that I actually matter to people
I let ambition completely consume me
I trust people I probably shouldn't

questions.question: How would your coworkers describe you behind your back?

answers.text: Eager, sensitive, endlessly loyal
Unpredictable, brilliant, and a little unhinged
The moral center of the whole group
Intimidating, but weirdly magnetic

questions.question: Pick a soundtrack for your life right now.

answers.text: Something chaotic and orchestral, building to a total breakdown
Something somber and haunting, the kind that plays as arms rise to the sky
Old sea shanties, sung slightly off-key
Something spiritual, something searching
I'm taken down by someone on my own side
I'm left completely alone with only my own delusions
I have to give up everything I ever actually wanted
I keep everyone else afloat while quietly drowning myself

results.name: Norman Osborn / Green Goblin
results.subtitle: Spider-Man (2002)
results.description: You're brilliant, a little unhinged, and prone to full-blown arguments with your own reflection when the pressure gets high enough. When Dafoe brought the Goblin back nearly two decades later in No Way Home, it deliberately echoed that same split-personality mirror scene — because that duality is basically your whole personality.

results.name: Sgt. Elias
results.subtitle: Platoon (1986)
results.description: You're the moral center of every room you're in, even when it costs you everything. Elias's death — arms thrown up toward a departing helicopter as he's gunned down — became one of the most iconic images in war-movie history, and Dafoe has said the gesture itself wasn't even planned, just pure instinct.

results.name: Thomas Wake
results.subtitle: The Lighthouse (2019)
results.description: You need to be in control, you love a dramatic monologue, and you will absolutely gaslight someone before admitting you're wrong. Dafoe's Wake is a grizzled, authoritarian lighthouse keeper who talks like an old sea god and dominates every scene he's in, calm one second and stormy the next.

results.name: Jesus
results.subtitle: The Last Temptation of Christ (1988)
results.description: You carry more than people realize, and you doubt yourself constantly right up until the moment it matters most. Scorsese's controversial adaptation of Nikos Kazantzakis's novel depicts a reluctant, self-doubting Jesus gradually coming to accept his divinity and fate, and Dafoe plays it with a rare, quiet sensitivity.

results.name: Bobby
results.subtitle: The Florida Project (2017)
results.description: You're the one everyone quietly relies on, even if you never get properly thanked for it. As the motel manager, Dafoe is the glue that binds the film's whole world, keeping a watchful eye on struggling tenants while carrying his own unspoken regrets just beneath the surface.

results.name: Nuidis Vulko
results.subtitle: Aquaman (2018)
results.description: You're the wise one who ends up shaping someone else's whole destiny, sometimes at real personal risk. As the mentor assigned to train young Arthur Curry in his mother's absence, Vulko guides and influences how Arthur eventually navigates the war for Atlantis's throne.

results.name: John LeTour
results.subtitle: Light Sleeper (1992)
results.description: You're a little haunted, a little insomniac, and you process everything by wandering rather than talking about it. Dafoe plays a high-class drug dealer battling a midlife crisis in this gritty neo-noir, a man whose chronic insomnia mirrors just how lost he's become.

results.name: Klaus Daimler
results.subtitle: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou (2004)
results.description: You're eager to please, wildly sensitive, and just want your loyalty to actually be noticed for once. Dafoe called this against-type role his loyal, long-suffering first mate — a German engineer so devoted to his captain he'll jump in the ocean fully clothed without a second thought.
